blends.name: A Blueberry Milkshake
blends.desc: Blending is a great way to turn things into other things. For example, if you have 10 blueberries, you can blend them into a blueberry milkshake. Try it! You'll like it. Remember, by blending the ingredients, they will irreversibly be changed from one form into another. Just like you can't reverse the arrow of time and unbreak a glass or unspill the milk, you can't unblend a blueberry shake. You have been warned.
